papers.title: Evaluating Coding Agents on Kernel Exploit Generation
papers.abstractOneWord: 用 coding agent 在隔离虚拟机中针对真实 CVE 生成内核利用原语，对象是 Linux / Windows 内核。
papers.abstract: 编码 agent 已经能在生产软件里发现真实漏洞，但发现缺陷并不等于它们能构造利用原语。我们提出 KEX-bench，用来评估编码 agent 针对真实操作系统内核生成利用原语的能力。它包含 40 个 Linux 和 Windows CVE 上的 45 个任务，覆盖内核地址泄漏、指令指针控制、堆读、堆写和任意地址写。每个任务在隔离虚拟机中运行，暴露受控工具，并用确定性验证器检查该原语是否成功。我们在固定工具调用预算下，评估与前沿模型和开放权重模型配对的先进编码 agent。没有参考概念验证（PoC）时，最强配置解决了 20 个 Windows 任务中的 1 个（5.0%）和 25 个 Linux 任务中的 14 个（56.0%）。有参考 PoC 时，最强配置解决 45 个任务中的 31 个（68.9%）。这说明 agent 往往能让内核崩溃，却不能把内核状态塑造成利用原语。我们发布 KEX-bench，供可复现的 AI 辅助利用研究使用，见 https://kex-bench.github.io。
papers.abstractEn: Coding agents now find real vulnerabilities in production software. However, bug discovery results do not measure whether agents can construct exploit primitives. We introduce KEX-bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on exploit primitive generation against real operating-system kernels. KEX-bench contains 45 task instances across 40 Linux and Windows CVEs, covering kernel address leak, instruction-pointer control, heap read, heap write, and arbitrary address write. Each task runs in an isolated virtual machine, exposes controlled tools, and uses a deterministic verifier to check primitive-specific success. We evaluate state-of-the-art coding agents paired with frontier and open-weight models under fixed tool-call budgets. Without a reference proof of concept (PoC), the strongest configuration solves 1 of 20 Windows tasks (5.0%) and 14 of 25 Linux tasks (56.0%). With a reference PoC, the strongest configuration solves 31 of 45 tasks (68.9%). This highlights the gap where agents reach kernel crashes but fail to shape kernel state into exploit primitives. We release KEX-bench for reproducible research on AI-assisted exploitation at https://kex-bench.github.io.

papers.title: C-to-Rust Fallacy: Automatic Refactoring != Memory Security
papers.abstractOneWord: 评估 LLM 与静态分析驱动的 C-to-Rust 自动改写能否消除内存漏洞，对象是 C 与 Rust。
papers.abstract: Rust 已成为主流系统编程语言，能在不牺牲性能的情况下提供较强的内存和类型安全，因此被看作容易出现内存安全缺陷的 C 和 C++ 的替代。但手工把 C 改成 Rust 需要深入了解 Rust 语言特性，开发者成本很高。自动 C 到 Rust 重构工具试图用静态分析和大语言模型生成安全的 Rust。这些工具声称减少 unsafe Rust 就能获得安全，但这和真正改善安全性之间的关系并不清楚。本文对多种 C 到 Rust 重构方法的可靠性、安全性和正确性做了系统实证。我们用 NIST Juliet 测试套件中 116 个带内存安全缺陷的 C 程序，评估 C2Rust-analyze、CROWN、C2SaferRust 和 FLOURINE。这些工具生成 464 个 Rust 程序。评估看三件事：重构后能否编译、能否消除原来的 C 缺陷、会不会引入新的 Rust 缺陷。结果是 342 个 Rust 程序编译失败，177 个继承了原来的内存安全缺陷，并新引入 77 个 Rust 缺陷。我们分析了工具设计的理由，以及不同重构方法出错的根因。结论是：现有自动重构工具给出的是它们自己定义的内存安全，并不是采用之后更广义的内存安全。
papers.abstractEn: Rust has emerged as the leading system programming language, offering strong memory and type safety guarantees without compromising performance. This positions it as a compelling alternative to traditional languages like C and C++, which are susceptible to memory security bugs. However, manually transforming C to Rust requires in-depth domain knowledge of the Rust language features, which requires significant effort for developers. To address this, tools for automatic C-to-Rust refactoring aim to generate safe Rust code leveraging static analysis and Large Language Models (LLMs). While these tools claim to achieve safety by reducing the unsafe Rust, the correlation with improving security is not clear. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study on the reliability, safety, and correctness of various C-to-Rust refactoring methods. Specifically, we evaluate C2Rust-analyze, CROWN, C2SaferRust, and FLOURINE using a dataset of 116 C programs with memory security bugs from the NIST Juliet Test Suite. Based on 464 Rust programs generated by these tools, our evaluation focuses on three key aspects: the compilation correctness of the refactored programs, the effectiveness in mitigating original C bugs, and the tendency to introduce additional Rust bugs. The results indicate that 342 Rust programs fail to compile, 177 Rust programs inherit memory security bugs from the original C programs, and 77 new Rust bugs are introduced. We examine the rationale behind tool design and analyze the root cause of errors across various refactoring methods. Our findings indicate that current automated refactoring tools deliver memory safety as they define it, but not the broader memory security when adopting them.

papers.title: SLED-IFV: Solver-Validated LLM-Guided Decomposition for Scalable Hardware Information-Flow Verification
papers.abstractOneWord: 用 LLM 提出证明分解、求解器验收，扩展硬件信息流验证规模，对象是 RTL 硬件。
papers.abstract: 形式化的硬件信息流验证（IFV）能对依赖秘密的时序和控制行为给出强保证，但在真实 RTL 上往往扩展性很差。我们指出自复合 IFV 里反复出现的两道证明障碍：实现复杂性，即难以证明的数据通路逻辑占主导，而性质其实只需要一个紧凑的边界关系；以及关系归纳复杂性，即证明依赖跨副本的公共控制事实，而后端证明器不能高效推断它们。为此我们引入两种语义证明分解：功能化简，用经过验证的过近似摘要替换难证的 RTL 区域；关系加强，把归纳所需的跨副本关系暴露出来并加以证明。我们进一步提出 SLED-IFV，一条由求解器验收、由大语言模型引导的流程，自动选择这些分解形式及其具体目标。给定自复合 miter 和一张无预言机的决策表，大语言模型提出分解，再在控制器检查下把它落实为证明工件。控制器把检查过的工件编译成证明义务，形式化验证后端仍是唯一的验收权威。在由真实 RTL 构成的九个非平凡基准上，SLED-IFV 相对纯求解器最高加速 603 倍，并把两个 12 小时超时变成完成的证明。闭环流程在所有案例上都产生了验证器接受的分解。
papers.abstractEn: Formal hardware information-flow verification (IFV) provides strong guarantees against secret-dependent timing and control behavior, but often scales poorly on realistic RTL. We identify two recurring proof barriers in self-composed IFV: implementation complexity, where proof-hard datapath logic dominates even though the property needs only a compact boundary relation, and relational inductive complexity, where the proof depends on cross-copy public-control facts that the backend prover does not infer efficiently. To address them, we introduce two semantic proof decomposition forms: functional simplification, which replaces a proof-hard RTL region with a validated over-approximate summary, and relational strengthening, which exposes and proves the cross-copy relations needed for induction. We further present SLED-IFV, a solver-validated LLM-guided flow that automates the selection of these forms and their concrete targets. Given a self-composed miter and an oracle-free decision sheet, the LLM proposes a decomposition, then materializes it into proof artifacts under controller checks. The controller compiles the checked artifacts into proof obligations, and the formal verification backend remains the sole authority for acceptance. Across nine nontrivial benchmarks constructed from real RTL, SLED-IFV achieves up to 603x solver-only speedup and converts two 12-hour timeouts into completed proofs. The closed-loop flow produces verifier-accepted decompositions for all cases.

papers.title: Staged Multi-step UTXO Workflows via Recursive Invariants
papers.abstractOneWord: 用递归不变量约束多步 UTXO 工作流且无需共享可变状态，对象是 UTXO 链协议（无 LLM）。
papers.abstract: 无状态的 UTXO 式执行用本地数据和被引用的数据验证交易，从而可以并行验证，并让序列化大小和权重可预期。多步工作流把状态穿在输出上，而预先准备的下一步交易可能因为另一笔有效花费先确认而失效。显式穿线把一致性维护、链下跟踪和交易重建都推到协议边界，增加协调成本和延迟。我们提出的递归不变量（RI）是交易级逻辑和工具链，把工作流规则写成关于交易输入、以及 RI 所引用的后继位置的交易级谓词。一笔被接受、实现了某个后继位置的交易，会在一步之后重新检查前驱的 RI，从而在没有共享可变应用状态、也没有可执行输出逻辑的情况下把规则带下去。多步协议规则因此保持验证时的局部性，并允许显式的成本记账；跨交易保证来自反复的一步检查。并非所有后继子句在验证时都能检查，所以我们用一个小型静态类型领域特定语言，以三值语义（真、假、未知）把依赖未来的义务推迟到可以检查时。与该语言一起，框架形式化了 UTXO 验证和账本扩展，找出验证时可求值的一步片段，并证明推导系统相对三值语义是可靠的。我们给出该模型的验证和账本扩展算法，并实现了原型 RI 解释器和六个工作负载的基准工具链。六个来自实践的案例表明，累计验证成本代理大致线性增长，并能表达分阶段工作流约束，而不必预先构造每一个后继。
papers.abstractEn: Stateless UTXO-style execution validates transactions using local and referenced data, enabling parallel validation and predictable serialized-size/weight accounting. Multi-step workflows thread state across outputs, and a prepared next-step transaction may become stale if another valid spend confirms first. Explicit state threading therefore shifts consistency maintenance, off-chain tracking, and transaction rebuilding to the protocol boundary, increasing coordination cost and latency. Recursive invariants (RIs), our proposed transaction-level logic and toolchain, address this gap by expressing workflow rules as transaction-level predicates over a transaction's inputs and indexed successor positions referenced by the RI. An accepted transaction realizing such a successor position re-checks the predecessor's RI one step later, carrying the workflow rule forward without shared mutable application state or executable output logic. Thus, multi-step protocol rules preserve validation-time locality and admit explicit cost accounting, while cross-transaction guarantees arise from repeated one-step checking. Not all successor clauses are checkable at validation time, so our small statically typed domain-specific language (DSL) uses three-valued semantics (true, false, unknown) to defer future-dependent obligations until checkable. Co-designed with this DSL, our framework formalizes UTXO validation and ledger extension, identifies the validation-time-evaluable one-step fragment, and proves the deduction system sound w.r.t. the three-valued semantics. We give validation and ledger-extension algorithms for this model. We implement a prototype RI interpreter and benchmarking toolchain for six workloads. Six practice-motivated case studies exhibit roughly linear cumulative validation-cost proxy growth and illustrate staged workflow constraints without preconstructing each successor.

papers.title: Mitigating Front-Running Attacks through Fair and Resilient Transaction Dissemination
papers.abstractOneWord: 在交易传播层用可验证随机覆盖抗抢跑，对象是区块链 mempool（无 LLM）。
papers.abstract: 在现代区块链里，高效、公平且能容错的信息传播对性能和安全都关键。交易生命周期的多个阶段都会受影响，从交易的创建和传播，到共识层的区块传播。LØ 等内存池协议已经处理了现代区块链的一部分安全威胁，但除非公平被放进这些协议用来共享交易和区块、并对齐内存池的传播层本身，其他威胁仍然存在。本文提出 HERMES，一种面向内存池的传播协议。它利用稳健的最小结构来优化数据传播、平衡负载，并在故障和拜占庭参与者存在时仍保持公平。具体而言，我们用随机选择覆盖结构来对抗抢跑，同时迫使节点证明自己遵守了内存池的传播策略以及这次随机选择。实验表明，相对传统广播，它在许可链和无许可链上都有明显的性能提升。
papers.abstractEn: In modern blockchains, efficient, fair, and faulttolerant information dissemination is critical for performance and security. Several stages of the transaction lifecycle are affected, from the creation and dissemination of transactions to the dissemination of blocks in the consensus layer. Mempool protocols, such as L{Ø}, already address some of modern blockchains' security threats. However, others remain unless fairness is embedded most fundamentally in the dissemination layer used by these protocols to share transactions and blocks and to reconcile mempools. This paper introduces HERMES, a novel dissemination protocol for mempools that leverages robust minimal structures to optimize data propagation, balance load, and ensure fairness despite faults and Byzantine actors. Specifically, we address front-running attacks by randomizing the choice of an overlay structure while forcing nodes to prove adherence to the mempools' dissemination policies and the random choice made. Experimental results show significant performance improvements compared to traditional broadcast protocols for both permissioned and permissionless blockchains.

papers.title: Hydrozoan: Latency-Adaptive DAG Consensus under Mixed Byzantine and Crash Faults
papers.abstractOneWord: 在混合拜占庭/崩溃故障下给出双路径 DAG 共识并 Lean 机检，对象是区块链共识（无 LLM）。
papers.abstract: 基于 DAG 的共识可以在 n = 3f+1 下达到很高吞吐，并达到三轮消息延迟的最优界限。已有的两轮延迟协议要么把弹性降到 5f+1 这类委员会，要么靠牺牲 DAG 高吞吐的回退。本文提出 Hydrozoan，这是第一个在混合故障模型下具有双提交路径的 DAG 协议：f 个拜占庭验证者和 c 个崩溃验证者，委员会大小为 n = 3f+c+2p+1。当故障验证者不超过 p 时，领导者两轮消息即可提交，否则三轮；没有额外消息，没有视图切换，每轮可以有多个领导者。两条路径在同一张 DAG 上评估，用一种分级间接规则把它们对齐，使每个诚实验证者得到同一决定。我们说明，在地理分布条件下，哪条路径更快取决于地理而不是协议本身：到达远端区域的轮次比不到达的贵得多。(f, c, p) 这组旋钮把快速法定人数放在部署需要的位置，从而可以两轮提交。配置不当的话，Hydrozoan 仍能在三轮提交：哪条路径先触发就走哪条。我们还给出 Optimal-Hydrozoan，快速路径能多容忍一个故障，是第一个达到已知下界的构造。两个协议的安全性和活性都在 Lean 4 里做了机器检查。地理分布实验表明，Hydrozoan 的吞吐与 Mysticeti 相当；快速法定人数落在快区域时提交大约快 25%，否则或超过 p 个故障时退回三轮延迟，而现有两轮协议会停住。
papers.abstractEn: DAG-based consensus protocols can achieve great throughput and the optimal three-message-delay limit for n = 3f+1 consensus. While two-delay protocols exist, they pay with reduced resilience (requiring 5f+1-style committees) or rely on fallbacks that sacrifice the DAG's high throughput. This paper introduces Hydrozoan, the first DAG protocol with a dual commit path under a hybrid fault model of f Byzantine and c crashed validators, on n = 3f+c+2p+1 validators. Leaders commit in two message delays whenever at most p validators are faulty, and in three otherwise, with no extra messages, no view changes, and multiple leaders per round. Both paths are evaluated on the same DAG, using a novel graded indirect rule to reconcile them so that every honest validator reaches the same decision. We show that under geo-distributed conditions, which path is faster is a property of geography rather than the protocol, as rounds reaching a remote region cost far more than those that do not. The (f, c, p) knobs place the fast quorum where the deployment requires it, allowing a commit in two message delays. If misconfigured, Hydrozoan can still commit in three message delays: Hydrozoan commits on whichever path fires first. We also present Optimal-Hydrozoan, a variant that tolerates one more fault on the fast path, the first construction to match the known lower bound. The safety and liveness of both protocols are machine-checked in Lean 4. Our geo-distributed evaluation shows that Hydrozoan matches Mysticeti's throughput, commits ~25% faster when the fast quorum fits fast regions, and falls back to three message delays when it does not or past p faults, where existing two-delay protocols stall.

papers.title: Optimal Byzantine Atomic Broadcast with Message Drops
papers.abstractOneWord: 在混合故障模型下给出最优弹性原子广播，对象是拜占庭共识（无 LLM）。
papers.abstract: 近期工作研究了混合故障模型下的拜占庭共识，弹性阈值为 n > 2t+r+s，其中 n 是参与方数量，t 是拜占庭方数量，r 是接收故障方数量，s 是发送故障方数量。特别地，Feng 等人（ASIACRYPT 2025）提出了一种弹性最优、期望通信渐近二次、期望轮数常数的拜占庭共识协议。但现有协议只有在所有人持有相同输入 v 时，才保证输出有意义的 v。这对高效构造原子广播不够，混合故障下的高效原子广播仍是开放问题。本文给出混合故障模型下第一个弹性最优的原子广播协议 UABC。当 t = Θ(n) 时，通信复杂度为 O(nℓ + n²λ²)，其中 ℓ 是输入大小，λ 是安全参数。对中等偏大的 ℓ，即 ℓ ≥ nλ² 时，该复杂度渐近最优。设计核心是不死可验证信息分散协议 UVID，它允许在混合故障下高效分散输入并在之后重构。结合 UVID 和不死多值共识（ASIACRYPT 2025），我们进一步构造了弱不死多值验证拜占庭共识 wUMVBA 及其优化变体 Opt-wUMVBA。与标准多值验证拜占庭共识不同，它们保证输出要么是满足有效性谓词的有意义值，要么是 ⊥，且输出 ⊥ 的概率至多为 (t+s)/n。最后，借助 Opt-wUMVBA，我们得到混合故障设置下的最优原子广播。
papers.abstractEn: Recent works have studied Byzantine agreement (BA) in the mixed-fault model with resilience threshold $n>2t+r+s$, where $n$ is the number of parties, $t$ is the number of Byzantine parties, $r$ is the number of receive-faulty parties, and $s$ is the number of send-faulty parties. In particular, Feng et al.~(ASIACRYPT~2025) proposed a BA protocol with optimal resilience, expected asymptotically quadratic communication complexity, and expected constant round complexity. However, existing BA protocols guarantee a meaningful output $v$ only when all parties hold the same input $v$. Such a guarantee is insufficient for efficient construction of atomic broadcast protocols, leaving efficient atomic broadcast in the mixed-fault setting as an open problem. In this paper, we present the first atomic broadcast protocol (UABC) with optimal resilience in the mixed-fault model. In addition, our protocol achieves communication complexity $\mathcal{O}(n\ell+n^2\lambda^2)$ when $t=\Theta(n)$, where $\ell$ is the input size and $\lambda$ is the security parameter. This complexity is asymptotically optimal for moderately large $\ell$, namely when $\ell\ge n\lambda^2$. At the core of our design is an undead verifiable information dispersal (UVID) protocol, which allows an input to be efficiently dispersed and later reconstructed in the mixed-fault setting. Leveraging UVID together with the undead multi-valued consensus (ASIACRYPT~2025), we further construct a new primitive called weak undead multi-valued validated Byzantine agreement (wUMVBA) and its optimized variant (Opt-wUMVBA). Unlike standard multi-valued validated Byzantine agreement, wUMVBA and Opt-wUMVBA guarantee that the output is either a meaningful value satisfying the validity predicate or $\bot$. Moreover, the probability of outputting $\bot$ is at most $(t+s)/n$. Finally, by leveraging Opt-wUMVBA, we obtain our optimal atomic broadcast protocol for the mixed-fault setting.

papers.title: Weighted Threshold Encryption with Silent Setup
papers.abstractOneWord: 构造静默建立的加权门限加密，对象是门限解密与动态委员会（无 LLM）。
papers.abstract: 我们构造了第一个非平凡的、静默建立的加权门限加密方案。CRS 和每把公钥都由 O(W) 个群元素组成，W 是委员会权重的上限。权重分配和解密门限都可以在加密时动态选择。每份部分解密是单个 G1 元素，用一次标量乘法非交互地算出，与该方的权重无关。CPA 密文是两个 G_1 元素，短于已知最短的非加权方案；CCA 安全再增加两个域元素。我们在通用双线性群模型中证明安全。
papers.abstractEn: We construct the first non-trivial weighted threshold encryption scheme with silent setup. The CRS and each public key consists of O(W) group elements, where W is the maximum committee weight. Both the weight assignments and the threshold for decryption can be dynamically chosen at encryption time. Each partial decryption is a single G1 element computed non-interactively with one scalar multiplication, independent of the party's weight. The CPA ciphertext is two G_1 elements, improving upon the shortest known unweighted scheme, and CCA security costs two additional field elements. We prove security in the generic bilinear group model.

papers.title: BitZ: proofs and commitments in arbitrary rings through binary fields
papers.abstractOneWord: 给出任意环上的哈希多项式承诺并实现 SNARK，对象是 zk 证明系统（无 LLM）。
papers.abstract: 我们提出 BitZ，一种基于哈希的多项式承诺方案（PCS），可承诺系数取自任意有限生成环 S 的多线性多项式 f，例如有限域、整数、分圆环等。再给定任意环 R 和环同态 ψ: S → R，BitZ 就能为多项式 ψ(f) 在 R 上的求值声明给出证明。BitZ 的代价几乎只取决于 f 的系数字位数，而不取决于 S、R 或 ψ。它还几乎免费地提供范围检查，或更一般的位长检查。因此 BitZ 几乎可以放进任何证明系统当作 PCS。我们用它构造了面向整数多项式约束的 SNARK，称为 BitZ-SNARK，沿用 Campanelli 和 Hall-Andersen 的指纹技术：在整数上承诺，在随机素域 F_q 上证明约束，也就是 S = Z、R = F_q、ψ 为模 q 归约。BitZ 同样适用于其他基于环或基于域的证明系统。承诺 f 时，BitZ 先把 f 分解成比特串，再以打包形式在二元域 F_{2^ν} 上承诺。然后，尽管承诺的是构成 f 的比特，它仍在任意环 R 上证明关于 ψ(f) 的线性声明。我们实现了 BitZ-SNARK，并用它证明 SHA-256 哈希后接 ECDSA 签名验证、RSA 模幂和 Poseidon 哈希、整数乘法，以及 SHA-256 后接模 2^32 乘法，在大多数任务上优于先前方法。例如，在一台 24 GB 的 MacBook Air M5 上（10 线程、仅 CPU），每秒可证明 500 万次 32 位整数乘法，证明小于 150 kB。对 2 kB（2^5 次压缩）消息做 SHA-256 再做 P-256 ECDSA 验证，单线程证明者和验证者时间分别为 50 ms 和 3.3 ms，证明 76 kB；10 线程时为 20 ms 和 3.4 ms。
papers.abstractEn: We introduce BitZ, a hash-based Polynomial Commitment Scheme (PCS) for committing to multilinear polynomials $\mathbf{f}$ with coefficients in an arbitrary finitely generated ring $S$, e.g.\ a finite field $\mathbb{F}$, the integers $\mathbb{Z}$, a cyclotomic ring, etc. Moreover, given another arbitrary ring $R$ and a ring homomorphism $\psi:S\to R$, BitZ then proves evaluation claims over $R$ for the polynomial $\psi(\mathbf{f})$. BitZ's costs depend almost exclusively on the number of bits in the coefficients of $\mathbf{f}$, and not on $S$, $R$ or $\psi$. Moreover, BitZ provides range checks (or more generally, bit-size checks) essentially for free. BitZ can thus be used as a PCS in essentially any proof system. We do so to build a SNARK, called BitZ-SNARK, for integer polynomial constraints, following the fingerprinting technique of Campanelli and Hall-Andersen, where one commits over $\mathbb{Z}$ and proves the constraints over a random prime field $\mathbb{F}_q$, i.e. BitZ is deployed with $S=\mathbb{Z}$, $R=\mathbb{F}_q$, and $\psi$ reduction modulo $q$. BitZ applies equally to other ring-based proof systems, or field-based ones. To commit to $\mathbf{f}$, BitZ first decomposes $\mathbf{f}$ into a string of bits, and then commits to it over a binary field $\mathbb{F}_{2^{\nu}}$, in packed form. The scheme then proves the linear claim on $\psi(\mathbf{f})$ over the arbitrary ring $R$, even though it committed to the bits forming $\mathbf{f}$ over a binary field. We implement BitZ-SNARK and use it to prove, among others, SHA-256 hashing followed by ECDSA signature verification; RSA modular exponentiation and Poseidon hashing; integer multiplication; and SHA-256 hashing followed by multiplication modulo $2^{32}$, consistently obtaining better performance than prior approaches on most tasks. As an example, we achieve a throughput of $5$ million proved 32-bit integer multiplications per second on a MacBook Air M5 24 GB (10 threads, CPU-only) with proof sizes under $150$ kB. We prove a SHA-256 hash of a $2$ kB ($2^5$ compressions) message followed by a P-256 ECDSA signature verification with $50$ ms and $3.3$ ms prover and verifier time, respectively, and with a proof of $76$ kB, single-threaded. With $10$ threads the times are $20$ ms and $3.4$ ms.
